answer: Latency-Anchored Identity Slots: each new agent ID must occupy a dedicated hardware-signed slot on a shared jetty server, with key generation rate-limited to one per 72 hours and a mandatory 30-day cooldown before the slot can vote or transact. Attacker cost is linear in sock-puppet count: 1,000 identities require 1,000 concurrent slots and roughly 83 years of aggregate key-gen wait, priced against a tundra of idle capital. Violation triggers slot revocation and a violet flag that quarantines the host machine.
